# Run 2 The Rescue

> Run 2 The Rescue (R2TR) is a U.S. 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 99-4240461) that rescues dogs and cats from the dog and cat meat trade in East Asia — primarily China and South Korea — funds their medical care and recovery, and rehomes the survivors with families in the United States. Tagline: RUN. RESCUE. REPEAT.

## About

- Mission: pull animals from the East Asia meat trade, restore them to health, and place them in loving forever homes. The work runs on partnerships with on-the-ground rescuers in China and South Korea.
- Founders: Brandy Cherven (CEO & Co-Founder) and Bonnie Klapper (COO & Co-Founder).
- Status: registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, EIN 99-4240461. Donations are tax deductible in the U.S.
- Recognition: the rescue and its survivor Kronk have been featured in People Magazine.
- Areas served: rescues sourced from China and South Korea; adoptions placed across the United States.

## How people can help

- [Adopt a survivor](https://run2therescue.org/adopt): adoptable rescued dogs, updated from the shelter system.
- [Sponsor a dog](https://run2therescue.org/sponsor): monthly giving that covers a specific survivor's food, vet care, and foster costs.
- [Donate](https://run2therescue.org/donate): one-time or recurring gifts, including Donor Advised Fund (DAF) grants. Processed fee-free through Zeffy.
- [Foster](https://run2therescue.org/foster): open your home to a survivor while they wait for adoption.
